entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu Imran ibn Yazid, commonly known as Ibrahim al-Nakha'i, was an early Kufan jurist of the tabi'in. A pioneer of the use of ra'y and qiyas, al-Nakha'i influenced later Kufan jurists through his student Hammad ibn Abi Sulayman, including Abu Hanifa.
